Test Scenario: Home tab - portfolio summary is displayed
Test Steps:
1. Tap the Home tab
2. Read the portfolio summary card
Expected Result:
1. Home tab is selected
2. Portfolio summary card is displayed with all fields populated (invested, current value, returns etc.)

Test Scenario: Handpick Collections - High Returns count and list scroll
Test Steps:
1. Note the fund count shown on the "High Returns" tile
2. Tap the "High Returns" tile
3. Note the fund count in the list header
4. Scroll the list to the bottom, then back to the top
Expected Result:
1. Tile fund count equals the list header fund count
2. List scrolls to the bottom and back to the top without errors

Test Scenario: Open fund detail from High Returns list
Test Steps: 1. Tap the first fund in the list
Expected Result: 1. Fund detail screen opens for the selected fund

Test Scenario: One Time and Start SIP order pad defaults
Test Steps:
1. Tap "One Time"
2. Read default amount and the "Min. ₹..." text
3. Tap the quick-add amount button
4. Go back
5. Tap "Start SIP" (if available) and repeat the checks
6. Go back
Expected Result:
1. One Time: default amount equals the minimum amount shown
2. One Time: amount increases after quick-add
3. Start SIP (if applicable): default equals minimum and quick-add increases amount
4. If Start SIP is not available / does not open an order pad, step is skipped
